permissions: explicit operator approval for the selected local serial port
documented receiver heading calibration and uncertainty
limitations: Parser/serial adapter is software-tested only; no named GNSS receiver or compass has been accepted on physical hardware.
Supports checksum-verified NMEA GGA/RMC plus HDT, or HDM/HDG with explicit magnetic correction inputs.
Exact GNSS coordinates remain transient local parser state and are never part of the bearing event.
GGA/RMC pairing rejects stale, mismatched, low-quality, dead-reckoning, manual and simulated fixes.
Heading sigma must come from a device-specific calibration record; no generic accuracy claim is made.
Receiver-local station registry provisioning and surveyed reference-bearing validation are required before field use.
